'''Chapter 1191''' is titled "There's Still Loki".

==Cover Page==
The [[Straw Hat Pirates]] singing soul alongside a cat and a wolf. The lower left text reads "Soul never ages!"

==Short Summary==
After reeling from his injuries, [[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] reveals to [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] the true identity of [[Nerona Imu|Imu]], and urges him to escape as Imu returns in an even more monstrous form. Meanwhile, [[Nico Robin|Robin]] and [[Jaguar D. Saul|Saul]] bring [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] to the [[Owl Library]] to interpret [[Biblo]]. As Imu attacks Luffy and Gaban, [[Hajrudin]] and [[Loki]] arrive in time to protect them, and Luffy joins the duo in a combined strike on Imu.

==Long Summary==
[[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] forces himself to stand up as he himself wonders how he is still alive after being stabbed, but he knows that if he leaves his [[Gomu Gomu no Mi/Gear 5 Techniques|Gear 5]] form in this state it would be very bad for him. He walks over to the injured [[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]], who is upset that [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] sliced his arm off, and Luffy apologizes for it thinking he lost it trying to protect him, but Gaban retorts he only did it for [[Elbaph|Elbaph's]] sake. As he attends to his wound, Luffy asks Gaban who Imu is exactly, but Gaban says it is not something anyone should know in this [[Blue Planet|world]], although if he were to call him anything, it would be "God". Speaking of which, Imu, who had fallen into the Underworld as a result of his fight with Gaban, transforms into an even more monstrous appearance, while saying that had he known on [[God Valley]] just how powerful the [[Roger Pirates]] would become since that [[God Valley Incident|fateful day]], he would have made sure to destroy them all along with [[Rocks D. Xebec|Rocks]], and he flies back up to the Sun World.

At the [[Owl Library]], [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] is relieved to see the books were unharmed from the fire as [[Jaguar D. Saul|Saul]] asks him to communicate with [[Biblo]], as he feels he is trying to say something and Chopper's animal nature will enable him to understand what it is. Biblo says something to Chopper, which leaves him shocked.

Imu then appears before Luffy and Gaban and admits to the latter he is impressed to only lose an arm when facing [[Honebami Toshiro]], but Gaban sarcastically offers an applause knowing he only has one hand left. Imu declares that nothing will be left after his next attack as Gaban tells Luffy to take his crew and flee Elbaph, but Luffy refuses to do so. As Gaban readies to take the full force of Honebami Toshiro, [[Hajrudin]] arrives and strikes Imu with ''Gungnir'', which sends him flying back, but as he does he fires some ''Omen'' at Hajrudin, which explode as Imu slams into the tree trunk. 

Thankfully, Hajrudin protected himself with his shield, though it falls apart afterwards. He attends to Gaban who orders him to take Luffy and flee Elbaph, as he sees no way to defeat Imu. Luffy yells he is not going anywhere as he claims he can heal back up on his own quickly thanks to all the food he ate earlier, to Gaban's disbelief. He sees some ''Omen'' flying towards them but Hajrudin scoops up both Luffy and Gaban while using himself as a shield to block the attack. Gaban tells Hajrudin to fall back so they can come up with an effective plan, but Hajrudin proudly states that Elbaph will never yield and every warrior will gladly go down fighting. Gaban pointblank says to Hajrudin that fighting Imu means he will die, but Hajrudin says that is okay since Elbaph will still have [[Loki]], something the latter agrees with as he starts running towards them, having recovered enough from his injuries to rejoin the fight. Just as he arrives, Luffy recovers, all of which leaves Gaban incredulous. 

Together, Luffy, Hajrudin, and Loki unleash a combined attack called ''San Sho: Gokoku'', unleashing a powerful blast that blows Imu away despite blocking.

==Quick References==
===Chapter Notes===
* [[Scopper Gaban|Gaban]] reveals the true identity of [[Nerona Imu|Imu]] to [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]].
* Imu [[Akuma no Mi|transforms further]] and returns to the battle.
* At the [[Owl Library]], [[Jaguar D. Saul|Saul]] asks [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] to converse with [[Biblo]], since it seems like it might be important.
* [[Hajrudin]] arrives to protect Luffy and Gaban from Imu's attack and is later joined by [[Loki]].
** Having somehow recovered from his injuries, Luffy along with Hajrudin and Loki clashes with Imu.
